recipes.title: Crisp Celery & Black Pepper Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Soft skillet eggs folded with finely diced celery stalk, sweet onion, olive oil, and freshly cracked black pepper.
steps: Finely dice celery stalk and onion so they soften quickly and evenly.
Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and saute celery and onion for 3 minutes.
Whisk eggs with black pepper, fold gently until softly set, and finish with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Savory Celery, Onion & Soft Egg Oat Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm rolled oats simmered with sauteed celery stalk, tender onion, cracked black pepper, and a soft-cooked egg.
steps: Sweat thinly sliced celery stalk, diced onion, and minced garlic in olive oil for 3 minutes.
Add rolled oats and water, then simmer for 6 minutes until creamy.
Season with black pepper and top with a soft-boiled or poached egg.

recipes.title: Lemon Celery & Avocado Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Creamy mashed avocado topped with crisp diced celery stalk, fresh lemon juice, olive oil, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Toast whole-grain bread and mash ripe avocado with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Finely dice celery stalk and toss lightly with olive oil and black pepper.
Spread avocado on toast and spoon crisp seasoned celery on top.

recipes.title: Herbed Celery, Tomato & Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipes.summary: Protein-rich cottage cheese layered with crunchy celery stalk, ripe tomato, black pepper, dill, and olive oil.
steps: Slice celery stalk into thin crescents and dice ripe tomato.
Spoon cottage cheese into a shallow bowl and arrange celery and tomato on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and finish with chopped dill and cracked black pepper.

recipes.title: Skillet Celery, Onion & Sweet Potato Hash
recipes.summary: Golden diced sweet potato pan-roasted with celery stalk, sweet onion, bell pepper, garlic, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Dice sweet potato into small even cubes and cook in olive oil covered for 10 minutes.
Add sliced celery stalk, diced onion, and bell pepper, cooking uncovered until lightly browned.
Stir in minced garlic and black pepper for 1 minute before serving warm.

recipes.title: Lemon Celery & Cracked Pepper Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Lightly smashed chickpeas folded with crisp celery stalk, finely diced onion, lemon juice, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Rinse cooked chickpeas and lightly mash half of them with a fork for a creamy texture.
Fold in finely diced celery stalk, onion, chopped parsley, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Season generously with cracked black pepper and serve on greens or toast.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Apple & Walnut Crunch Salad
recipes.summary: Thinly shaved celery stalk and crisp apple tossed with toasted walnuts, lemon vinaigrette, parsley, and black pepper.
steps: Thinly slice celery stalk on a diagonal and matchstick crisp apple.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, and cracked black pepper in a mixing bowl.
Toss celery, apple, chopped parsley, and toasted walnuts right before serving.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Celery & Tuna Lettuce Wrap
recipes.summary: Olive-oil tuna tossed with crunchy celery stalk, minced onion, fresh lemon, and black pepper tucked into crisp lettuce leaves.
steps: Flake drained tuna into a bowl with finely diced celery stalk and minced onion.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and freshly ground black pepper.
Spoon the mixture into washed crisp lettuce cups and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Quick Celery, Onion & Red Lentil Potage
recipes.summary: Comforting red lentil soup built on a fragrant base of celery stalk, onion, carrot, garlic, turmeric, and black pepper.
steps: Saute diced celery stalk, onion, and carrot in olive oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in garlic, turmeric, and black pepper, then add rinsed red lentils and broth or water.
Simmer 18 minutes until lentils soften completely and blend partially if a smoother bowl is preferred.

recipes.title: Warm Garlic Celery & White Bean Tartine
recipes.summary: Tender braised celery stalk and white beans warmed with onion, garlic, lemon zest, olive oil, and black pepper over toast.
steps: Warm sliced celery stalk, diced onion, and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Fold in rinsed white beans, a splash of water, lemon juice, and black pepper, simmering 5 minutes.
Spoon warm beans and celery over toasted whole-grain bread.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Onion & Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Fast weeknight stir-fry pairing sliced chicken with crisp-tender celery stalk, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, and black pepper.
steps: Sear bite-sized chicken pieces in sesame oil until lightly golden, then set aside briefly.
Stir-fry diagonally sliced celery stalk, onion, grated ginger, and garlic for 3 minutes.
Return chicken to the pan with soy sauce and cracked black pepper, tossing 2 minutes until glossy.

recipes.title: Braised Celery, Onion & Lemon Baked Cod
recipes.summary: Tender baked cod nestled over softly braised celery stalk, sweet onion, garlic, olive oil, lemon, and black pepper.
steps: Spread sliced celery stalk, onion, and garlic in a baking dish with olive oil and roast 10 minutes at 400F.
Nestle cod fillets on top, squeeze fresh lemon over the fish, and season with black pepper.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until the fish flakes gently and scatter with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Celery, Carrot & Thyme Roast Chicken
recipes.summary: One-pan roasted celery stalk, sweet carrots, onion, garlic, and herb-rubbed chicken seasoned with thyme and black pepper.
steps: Toss thick-cut celery stalk, carrots, onion wedges, and garlic cloves with olive oil, thyme, and black pepper.
Arrange seasoned chicken pieces among the vegetables on a lined sheet pan.
Roast at 400F for 25 to 30 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Celery, Onion & Tofu Rice Skillet
recipes.summary: Savory one-skillet rice bowl with crisp celery stalk, browned tofu, sweet onion, bell pepper, garlic, and bold black pepper.
steps: Brown cubed firm tofu in olive oil for 6 minutes until edges are lightly crisp.
Add sliced celery stalk, diced onion, bell pepper, and garlic, cooking 4 minutes.
Fold in cooked rice and freshly cracked black pepper until warmed through.

recipes.title: Velvety Roasted Celery, Potato & Onion Soup
recipes.summary: Smooth, easy-to-swallow soup blending sweet celery stalk, tender potato, sauteed onion, garlic, thyme, and black pepper.
steps: Saute chopped celery stalk, onion, and garlic in olive oil with thyme for 6 minutes.
Add diced potato and water or broth, simmering 18 minutes until completely fork-tender.
Blend smooth until velvety and finish with a light grind of black pepper.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Green Apple & Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright green blend of chopped celery stalk, crisp apple, spinach, fresh ginger, lemon juice, and chilled water.
steps: Chop celery stalk into 1-inch pieces to cut across fibers before blending.
Combine celery, cored apple, spinach, grated ginger, lemon juice, and cold water in a blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth.

recipes.title: Hydrating Celery, Pineapple & Mint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing tropical green smoothie with celery stalk, sweet pineapple, cool cucumber, fresh mint, lime, and coconut water.
steps: Add chopped celery stalk, peeled cucumber, and pineapple chunks to the blender.
Toss in fresh mint leaves, a squeeze of lime, and chilled coconut water.
Blend until silky smooth and serve immediately over ice if desired.

recipes.title: Creamy Celery, Avocado & Greek Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky, filling smoothie blending celery stalk, ripe avocado, Greek yogurt, cucumber, lemon, and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Slice celery stalk and cucumber thinly so they puree effortlessly.
Blend with avocado, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, honey, and cold water until creamy.
Adjust water for a lighter sip or thicker spoonable texture.

recipes.title: Celery, Blueberry & Oat Morning Smoothie
recipes.summary: Mild-tasting purple berry smoothie hiding finely chopped celery stalk with blueberries, oats, banana, cinnamon, and almond milk.
steps: Soak rolled oats in almond milk inside the blender jar for 2 minutes.
Add chopped celery stalk, blueberries, banana, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Blend on high until velvety with no visible celery strands.

recipes.title: Cool Celery, Pear & Spinach Lime Smoothie
recipes.summary: Naturally sweet ripe pear balanced with crisp celery stalk, baby spinach, bright lime, and a hint of fresh ginger.
steps: Core ripe pear and slice celery stalk into short rounds.
Place pear, celery, spinach, lime juice, grated ginger, and chilled water into a blender.
Puree until smooth and frosty.

recipes.title: Classic Cold-Pressed Celery & Lemon Juice
recipes.summary: Clean, crisp fresh celery stalk juice brightened with fresh lemon; works in a juicer or blended and strained.
steps: Wash crisp celery stalks thoroughly and trim the dry base ends.
Feed celery through a juicer (or blend with a splash of water and strain through a fine mesh).
Stir in freshly squeezed lemon juice and drink chilled.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Apple & Cucumber Mint Cooler
recipes.summary: Lightly sweet green juice combining celery stalk, apple, cool cucumber, garden mint, and a splash of lemon.
steps: Rinse celery stalk, apple, cucumber, and mint sprigs, then quarter the apple.
Juice all produce together or blend with a small splash of water and strain.
Finish with lemon juice and serve cold.

recipes.title: Bright Celery, Carrot, Ginger & Black Pepper Tonic
recipes.summary: Vibrant golden-green juice pairing celery stalk, sweet carrot, fresh ginger, turmeric, lemon, and a pinch of black pepper.
steps: Scrub carrots and rinse celery stalk and fresh ginger root.
Juice celery, carrots, ginger, and turmeric (or blend with water and strain smooth).
Stir in fresh lemon juice and a pinch of finely ground black pepper before serving.

recipes.title: Zesty Celery, Pineapple & Lime Refresher
recipes.summary: Sweet-tart juice balancing fresh celery stalk with juicy pineapple, fresh ginger, and bright lime.
steps: Cut celery stalk into lengths and trim fresh pineapple into spears.
Juice celery, pineapple, and a small coin of ginger together.
Squeeze in fresh lime juice, stir well, and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Ruby Celery, Beet & Green Apple Press
recipes.summary: Earthy-crisp ruby juice blending fresh celery stalk, scrubbed red beet, crisp apple, ginger, and fresh lemon.
steps: Scrub and quarter raw beet and apple, and chop celery stalk into juicer-ready pieces.
Alternate feeding beet, celery, apple, and ginger through the juicer for the best yield.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and chill briefly before serving.
